name: Tank Upgrades
hook: Shoot shapes, level up, outgun every other tank.
how: Break shapes for XP. Every level gives you a point for Speed, Reload, Damage or Armor, and at level 10 you pick a new tank: Twin, Sniper or Gunner. Destroy another tank to take half its score.
controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click to shoot, 1–4 to upgrade; two thumb sticks on touch
uses: Each player's best score in one life, shown when you're destroyed.
The host's browser runs the shapes and decides who broke them; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots of every level fill the arena until enough people join.
Every tank and bullet shows up for everyone at once; whoever gets hit says so.
